claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: The witness only reports an IBC-style caged tank with valves/outlet area; no markings or certification are shown to confirm intended chemical/hazard use.
No readable brand/grade/food-contact certification plate or markings are visible; only faint markings are reported.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No service history, cleaning proof, or last-contents documentation is shown; condition details like residue/odor are not reported.
The witness does not report leak testing or close inspection for cracks; only general visual features are described.
The witness mentions curved protective bars and a valve area, but does not confirm lid completeness or whether all caps/fittings are present.

risks.risk: Capacity/volume is unknown, which strongly affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the capacity/volume rating label (liters/gal) and any model/serial plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-capacity used IBC-style tank (worst-case value for smaller/uncertain size).

risks.risk: Food-grade vs chemical-grade is not verifiable; wrong grade can make it unusable for intended purpose.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of any food-contact/grade marking (e.g., FDA/food-grade stamp) or readable certification/plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified grade (worst-case: treated as chemical/unknown grade).

risks.risk: Leak/crack risk: visual inspection may miss hairline cracks, seam failures, or valve seal wear.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the tank filled/pressurized test or a close-up of the outlet/valve seals plus underside/base inspection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing seal/valve replacement (worst-case: 'as-is, not guaranteed watertight').

risks.risk: Valve/tap condition and completeness are unknown; missing parts or worn threads reduce usability.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the blue-handled valve/tap showing the full assembly, threads, and any missing caps/fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'valve condition unknown' (worst-case: assume parts may be missing or require replacement).

risks.risk: Cage/frame integrity and transport damage (bent base, missing bars) can affect safety and handling.
risks.proof: Photos of the entire frame from all sides and the base/pallet area showing straightness and any missing cage bars.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'frame condition unknown' (worst-case: assume transport damage may require repair).

risks.risk: Last contents contamination risk (even if 'clean water' claimed) can make it unsafe for food use.
risks.proof: Photos of interior/cleaning state (if accessible) and any cleaning/flush documentation; also a close-up of any residue/staining.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'unknown prior contents' (worst-case: discounted for potential re-cleaning/limited use).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the capacity/volume rating label (liters) and any model/serial plate.
Close-up photo of any food-grade/food-contact certification markings (or lack of them).
Video/clip of a leak test or demonstration of watertightness (including around the valve/outlet and lid area).
Close-up photos of the full valve/tap assembly and all included fittings/caps (showing completeness).
Photos of the underside/base and full cage/frame from multiple angles to confirm no bent parts or missing bars.
response.reason: The witness consistently identifies the item type as an IBC-style caged water/storage tank, so it can be priced at its worst-case value. However, grade, capacity, leak status, and completeness are not verifiable from the report, so the price should be discounted accordingly until the requested proof is provided.
